title: Recordkeeping requirements.
bodyText: An owner or operator subject to section 342D-104 shall record the information required to be gathered under that section and shall maintain the records for three years after the date the information was gathered.
bodyHtml: [§342D-105]  Recordkeeping requirements.  An owner or operator subject to section 342D-104 shall record the information required to be gathered under that section and shall maintain the records for three years after the date the information was gathered. [L 2005, c 217, pt of §1]
